'''0.16b''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that changed [[Teamplay]] to be 10v10 and adjusted some [[ammunition]] and [[Weapons|weapon]] stats.

==Changelog==
* 10 vs. 10 gameplay implemented
* Reduced the weight of some ammunition: [[Ammunition#5.45x39|5.45x39]], [[Ammunition#12x70|12x70]], [[Ammunition#.357|.357]]
* Reduced the damage from buckshot over distance
* Changed the recoil in the following weapons: [[TT-33]], [[Fort 17]], [[AKS-74U]], [[Vityaz]] and [[Uzi]]

===Bug fixes===
* Critical error leading to crash on anomalous zones buffer overfill fixed
